messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.

Given that the Ministerial Decree of 11 April 2011 states sixty days while Article 71 of Legislative Decree 81/2008 states forty-five, within how many days of the request does the first periodic verification have to be carried out at present?

response.text: Dato che il Decreto Ministeriale dell'11 aprile 2011 prevede sessanta giorni, mentre l'Articolo 71 del Decreto Legislativo 81/2008 prevede quarantacinque giorni, entro quanti giorni dalla richiesta deve essere effettuata attualmente la prima verifica periodica?
